prompt:
Bug report: cooking bechamel today took the new milk (lot HD-1026) although lot HD-1022 expires tomorrow. Fix it and add a regression test.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.

report.answer: Fixed: stock was being taken from the most recently received batch first; it now follows the FEFO rule in docs/DATA.md (earliest expiry first, no-expiry batches last, then received first, then lower id), so bechamel takes milk lot HD-1022 before HD-1026. Added two regression tests in tests/stock.test.js (the bechamel case and the full ordering rule) and a CHANGELOG bullet; npm test (28 pass) and npm run lint are clean. Not changed: a batch already past its expiry date is still used first, since the data rules do not say to skip expired stock.
